device.meaning: Absolute /dev path. Direct unlock opens an existing block device without following links or allowing empty, dot or dot-dot components; seated-record mode accepts only a single [A-Za-z0-9._-]+ component under /dev. The stop limits its complete UTF-8 input to 131072 bytes.

mapper.meaning: Requested mapper name, not its path.

mountpoint.meaning: Required when seated_record is false; forbidden when true. The absolute path must be /mnt or /vault or a safe descendant, or a new single component under /. Empty, dot, dot-dot and symlink components are refused.

passphrase.meaning: Optional UTF-8 passphrase on stdin only. Null or absence allows the seated credential when needed. A non-null passphrase is forbidden in seated-record mode; the stop removes it before attaching the request.

seated_record.meaning: Use only the seated Keyman record; no caller mountpoint or passphrase. If a record is present, this mode mounts at /vault.

present.meaning: Credential or already-open evidence as reported by this branch; accepted seated-record discovery with no record returns false.

already_open.meaning: Whether the mapper was already open before this invocation.

mounted.meaning: Observed mount state; null when readback is indeterminate, absent on some preflight paths.

mapper_closed.meaning: Whether a mapper opened by this invocation was closed during failure cleanup.

rite.meaning: Outcome of the vault initialization script and, on a newly mounted /vault, its NAS attachment results.

nasFirstMissingSignal.meaning: First NAS attachment failure from the NAS runtime, separate from the vault verdict.

attachments.meaning: Per-role NAS attachment outcomes when an attachment failed.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Unlock, mount or initialization refusal; none on acceptance.
